text: The school should definitely adopt the later start time. Firstly, full crossing-guard coverage will be confirmed for the shifted schedule, ensuring safety during mornings. Secondly, it would set a precedent by being the first district statewide to implement this model. Additionally, consolidating a bus route under the new times could save an estimated forty thousand dollars annually, demonstrating tangible financial benefits. Lastly, the pilot school has consistently seen improved attendance rates after switching to these later start times. These factors collectively support adopting the later start time for better student safety, educational outcomes, budgetary efficiency, and overall school readiness.
